description: NPC wrecks have a small chance to hold a blueprint (a copy, a T1 original or a T2 original). Salvaged wrecks keep blueprint copies as copies. Optional, off by default: pirate NET Resonator drops and faction loot tables. The data files are built from the EVE SDE.

fields.label: Blueprint drops
fields.description: NPC wrecks can hold a blueprint. Default: on.

fields.label: Chance per wreck: small hulls
fields.description: Chance (0-1) that a small-hull NPC wreck holds a blueprint. Default: 0.04.

fields.label: Chance per wreck: medium hulls
fields.description: Chance (0-1) for a medium-hull NPC wreck. Default: 0.08.

fields.label: Chance per wreck: large hulls
fields.description: Chance (0-1) for a large-hull NPC wreck. Default: 0.16.

fields.label: Chance per wreck: other
fields.description: Chance (0-1) for any other NPC wreck. Default: 0.06.

fields.label: Pirate NET Resonators
fields.description: Pirate NPCs can drop their faction's NET Resonator. EVEJS_BPDROPS_RESONATORS_ENABLED overrides this setting. Default: off.

fields.label: Faction loot tables
fields.description: Extra faction loot on NPC wrecks by tier and rarity. EVEJS_BPDROPS_FACTION_LOOT_ENABLED overrides this setting. Default: off.

fields.label: Log drops
fields.description: One console line per blueprint drop. Default: on.
